title: keeps a quit that is asked about from the gate, so Keep working leaves the app able to quit
why: A quit that is asked about goes on to the gate: the engine is stopped while the question is still on the screen, and Keep working keeps nothing.

title: stops the engine exactly as before once the person has said Quit anyway
why: The shutdown no longer started after the question: the quit the person confirmed is cancelled by the gate for a stop that never runs, and the app can never quit.

title: quits after Quit anyway, as the app’s own quit, and does not ask again
why: The quit the guard makes not marked as the app's own: the quit the person has just confirmed is asked about again, for ever.

title: does not ask about a quit already under way, nor the windows it closes
why: A quit under way no longer counted as the app's: the windows a quit closes are held by a question, which cancels the quit half way through its shutdown.

title: takes a second quit as the answer while the question is open, and takes the dialog back
why: The question left open after a second quit answered it: the dialog stays on a quitting app, and its buttons answer a question already answered.

title: does nothing for an answer to an earlier question
why: An answer taken for whichever question is open: a press on its way as one dialog closed quits the app from under the next.

find:
if (frame !== this.#listener) return
    const open = this.#open
title: does nothing for an answer from a frame that is not the listening page
why: An answer heard from any frame: a page that is not the one asked can quit the app.

replace:
// Cancel before it answered; the exports are stopped here too, since on
    // macOS no quit follows the window to do it.
title: stops the exports and then closes the window after Close anyway
why: Close anyway no longer stops the exports main holds: on macOS, where no quit follows the window, an export goes on with no window that can see or stop it.

title: does not ask about the close it makes itself, with the export still unwinding
why: The close the guard makes not let through: Close anyway is answered with the same question again, and the window never closes.

title: does not ask about the close it makes itself, with the export still unwinding
why: The pass for the guard's own close never spent: every later close of that window goes unasked, whatever is running.

title: takes a second close as the answer, and stops the exports itself
why: A second close goes ahead and stops nothing: on macOS the export goes on behind a window that is gone.

title: hears a report from the listening frame only
why: A report heard from any frame: a page that is not the one asked decides what a quit is asked about.

title: forgets the report with the page that made it
why: A page's report kept for the page that replaces it: a quit is asked about a layout that died with the renderer running it.

title: does not ask once the listening frame is no longer the window’s
why: A page asked though its frame is no longer the window's: the question goes to a document that is not on the screen, and the quit is held for it.

title: does not ask an unresponsive page, and asks again once it answers
why: Electron's report that the page is unresponsive ignored: a quit is held for a question the page cannot show.

title: names a project the store cannot name as the sentence’s fallback
why: A project the store cannot name said by its identifier: the sentence reads as twelve letters and digits.

title: drops the open question when the page goes, so the next quit is not held by it
why: A question kept open over a crash: an answer from the dead page's last moments quits the app after its window was loaded again.

find:
if (typeof project !== 'string' || validateId(project) !== null || seen.has(project))
      return null
title: the report’s shape
why: A report's identifiers no longer checked: any string the page sends is kept and looked up as a project.

title: refuses an answer that names no question or says neither word
why: An answer of any shape taken: a word that is neither keep nor anyway closes the question, and is carried out as a quit.

title: takes the report through its shape, and refuses one that is not a report
why: A report of the wrong shape dropped in silence: the page is never told that main is not hearing what it runs.
